xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5248: Agent typechecks and idle workspace frontends exhaust host memory: typechecks skip admission, idle frontends never stop (admission half; container half split to PAN-5250)

plan.title: Agent typechecks and idle workspace frontends exhaust host memory: typechecks skip admission, idle frontends never stop
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The plan touches 24 files (under the 25-file cap). The subsystem count is inflated by the heuristic, not by scope: root files (package.json, CLAUDE.md), each scripts/ file, tests/vitest-cpu-admission.ts, and the docs/changelog files the docs rule requires each count as their own 'subsystem'. Functionally this is one subsystem — the shared admission queue (src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.ts) and its three callers. The separable container half of the issue was already split into PAN-5250.

narratives.Problem: Agent-shell typechecks never enter the machine-wide admission queue: acquireQualityGateAdmission is called only by verification gates (src/lib/cloister/validation.ts) and the Vitest globalSetup (tests/vitest-cpu-admission.ts), so every tsc lane of npm run typecheck and the tsc lanes inside scripts/lint-effect-diagnostics.sh, lint-dashboard-types.sh and lint-frontend-types.sh run unadmitted. The queue also checks only CPU (sampleQualityGatePressure), never memory. On 2026-11-14 three overlapping typechecks (2.4, 2.2 and 1.2 GB) took MemAvailable to 2.4 GiB with swap full. Sampling MemAvailable alone would not have prevented it, because the three started seconds apart before any had allocated.
narratives.Proposal: Wrap every tsc lane in a new scripts/tsc-admitted.mjs that takes one admission per tsc process (bypassing under CI, OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 and OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1 without loading tsx). Make the queue memory-aware: the head waiter waits while MemAvailable minus the reservations of admitted-but-unpeaked owners minus its own footprint estimate would fall below resources.governor_soft_reserve_gb. Footprint estimates come from measured peak process-tree RSS, stored per footprint key (tsc:<tsconfig>, vitest:<dir>, gate:<name>:<command>) as the max of the last 5 peaks, with a 2.5 GiB default. A leaf /proc sampler measures peaks for the wrapper, Vitest and host verification gates; the admission handle records them. Docs, CLAUDE.md and a changelog entry describe the new rule.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Stopping, restarting, pinning or probing workspace containers (idle frontend/dev stop, in-use detection, restart on demand, activity-feed stop entries) — moved verbatim to PAN-5250.
- Admitting hand-typed npx tsc, node_modules/.bin/tsc or bare tsc invocations, sub-package package.json typecheck scripts, test:drizzle-smoke, eslint, or builds (tsdown, vite build).
- Admitting other projects' typechecks run in agent shells (only verification gates, which are already admitted, cover them).
- A PATH shim for tsc in the agent guard directory.
- Measuring peaks for container or remote gates; remote gates stay unadmitted.
- Peak sampling on macOS or Windows (the default estimate applies there).
- Shedding, pausing or killing running gates or agents under memory pressure (#3429).
- New config keys; the existing resources.governor_soft_reserve_gb and resources.quality_gate_slots are reused.
- Changing the existing '[quality-gate] Queued for CPU admission:' log text.
- A lint guard that fails when a future tsc lane skips the wrapper.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the issue: PAN-5248 keeps requirement 1 (typecheck admission and the memory-aware queue) plus its tests, PIPELINE-GATES/CLAUDE.md docs and changelog; requirements 2-4, the idle-timeout tests and the WORKSPACES doc moved verbatim to the new sibling issue PAN-5250.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both halves together touch about 40 files against finalize's 25-file cap, and they share no code (admission queue vs idle-stack reaper and Docker). The planning contract prefers independently shippable sibling issues.

autoDecisions.summary: Cover typechecks with an explicit wrapper (scripts/tsc-admitted.mjs) in every root typecheck lane and the three ratchet scripts, not a PATH shim; hand-typed npx tsc stays unadmitted.
autoDecisions.rationale: npm run and npx put node_modules/.bin first on PATH, so a tsc shim in the agent guard directory would never see the lanes that caused the incident. The issue's '`tsc --noEmit`' bullet is read as the root lane of npm run typecheck.

autoDecisions.summary: Subtract reservations of admitted owners: reservation = max(0, owner.footprintBytes - currentTreeRss(owner.pid)); an unreadable tree RSS reserves the full footprint.
autoDecisions.rationale: Sampling MemAvailable alone admits several gates that start seconds apart before any has allocated, which is exactly the incident.

autoDecisions.summary: Estimate = max of the last 5 recorded peaks per key; default 2.5 GiB; estimates clamp to memTotal - softReserve.
autoDecisions.rationale: Max keeps broad keys such as Vitest conservative; the default sits just above the largest measured lane (2.4 GB); the clamp stops a gate larger than the host from waiting forever.

autoDecisions.summary: No new config keys: reuse resources.governor_soft_reserve_gb (global config, loaded like quality_gate_slots) with a computeGovernorReserveDefaultsGb fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the soft reserve as the threshold, and config-yaml/schema.ts and merge.ts sit at their file-size allowlist caps.

autoDecisions.summary: The wrapper waits at most 30 minutes, then proceeds unadmitted with a warning, like the Vitest globalSetup.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps one consistent fail-open contract for agent-shell callers; verification gates keep their unbounded wait.

autoDecisions.summary: Footprint keys use the raw gate.command (before {{placeholder}} substitution) for verification gates.
autoDecisions.rationale: Placeholders such as {{CHANGED_BASE}} change every run and would fragment the store into single-use keys.

autoDecisions.summary: After the plan critique: a memory-wait timeout fails closed (exit 75 for the wrapper, a thrown error for Vitest); memory is re-checked after the settle; reservations subtract growth above an RSS baseline; container gates wait on memory with a full reservation.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each change answers a blocks-the-design finding in .pan/drafts/PAN-5248-critique.md; see the PRD's Critique response.

items.title: Add a leaf /proc process-tree RSS reader and peak sampler

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create src/lib/system-health/process-tree-rss.ts exporting readProcessTreeRssBytes(rootPid, reader?, platform?) and startPeakRssSampler(rootPid, { intervalMs = 2000, read }). Build the ppid map from /proc/<n>/stat (ppid is the second field after the last ')'), walk descendants breadth-first, sum VmRSS kB x 1024 from /proc/<pid>/status for tree members only, skip vanished members, return null on non-Linux or an unreadable root. The sampler reads once at start and on an unref'd interval, tracks the max non-null value, and stop() clears the interval, awaits an in-flight read and returns the max or null. Import only node built-ins (NFR-6: never import runaway-process-patrol.ts or memory-governor.ts). Tests use an in-memory ProcReader and fake timers.

items.title: Given an in-memory /proc with a 3-process tree and an unrelated sibling, readProcessTreeRssBytes returns the sum of VmRSS for the root and its 2 descendants only
Given a stat line whose comm contains ') (', the reader still parses ppid and includes the child in the tree
When platform is not linux, readProcessTreeRssBytes returns null without reading /proc
Given fake timers and reads of 100, 300, 200 bytes across ticks, stop() returns 300; when every read is null, stop() returns null and no read runs after stop()
Add the footprint store and memory headroom rule module

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 (decisions D5, D8, D9). Create src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-memory.ts exporting DEFAULT_GATE_FOOTPRINT_BYTES = 2.5 GiB, GATE_FOOTPRINT_HISTORY = 5, footprintStoreDir(root) = join(root, 'footprints'), readGateFootprintEstimate(key, root) (max of stored peaks, default when missing or torn), recordGateFootprintPeak(key, peakBytes, root, now?) (ignore non-finite or <= 0, keep newest 5, write temp file in the footprints dir then rename over <sha256(key) first 24 hex>.json holding { key, peaks: [{ bytes, at }] }), resolveSoftReserveBytes() (dynamic import of ../config-yaml/load.js, loadGlobalConfigNoMigration().config.resources.governorSoftReserveGb x GiB; on any error computeGovernorReserveDefaultsGb(os.totalmem()/GiB).soft x GiB from ../config-yaml/governor-reserves.js), evaluateMemoryHeadroom({ memAvailableBytes, memTotalBytes, softReserveBytes, estimateBytes, reservationsBytes }) -> { ok, footprintBytes, headroomBytes } with footprintBytes = min(estimate, max(0, memTotal - softReserve)), headroom = memAvailable - reservations - footprint, ok = headroom >= softReserve, and ownerReservationBytes(owner: { footprintBytes?, rssBaselineBytes?, fullReservation? }, treeRss|null) implementing PRD D4: the whole footprintBytes ?? 0 when fullReservation is true, the baseline is undefined or treeRss is null, else max(0, footprint - max(0, treeRss - baseline)). Never import memory-governor.ts.

items.title: readGateFootprintEstimate returns 2.5 GiB for a key with no file or a torn file, and returns the max of the recorded peaks otherwise
When a 6th peak is recorded for one key, the stored file contains only the newest 5 peaks

evaluateMemoryHeadroom returns ok=true exactly when headroom equals the soft reserve and ok=false one byte below it, and clamps footprintBytes to memTotal - softReserve on a host smaller than the estimate

ownerReservationBytes returns 2.4 GiB for a 2.5 GiB footprint with a 1 GiB baseline and a 1.1 GiB tree, and returns the whole footprint when the baseline is missing, the tree RSS is null or fullReservation is true
When the mocked loadGlobalConfigNoMigration throws, resolveSoftReserveBytes falls back to the computeGovernorReserveDefaultsGb soft value

metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: the memory rule, the incident replay, the recorded estimate, fail-open reads, recordPeak, and the baseline/full-reservation arithmetic are distinct observable behaviors of one loop change.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 (D4, D10, D11, D12). In src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.ts: add optional footprintKey and fullReservation to QualityGateAdmissionRequest; optional footprintBytes to AdmissionTicket (owners inherit it and fullReservation through the existing { ...ticket, acquiredAt } spread); optional rssBaselineBytes to AdmissionOwner, set from await readTreeRssBytes(pid) immediately before publishExclusive(path, owner) and omitted when null; footprintBytes and recordPeak(peakBytes) to QualityGateAdmissionHandle; deps sampleMemory, readTreeRssBytes, softReserveBytes, readFootprintEstimate, onWaiting; and export type QualityGateWaitReason = queue | slots | cpu | memory (memory carries memAvailableBytes, reservationsBytes, footprintBytes, softReserveBytes). Before publishing the ticket resolve the estimate when a key is present. During the slot scan collect non-stale observed owners; put the reservation sum in a local sumReservations(owners, readTreeRssBytes) helper that calls ownerReservationBytes(owner, treeRss) so the post-settle re-check (admission-settle-and-timeout) can reuse it. After the slots-full check and before samplePressure: when the request has a footprintKey and sampleMemory returns non-null with memAvailableBytes > 0 (a throw counts as null), sum the reservations of live owners, run evaluateMemoryHeadroom, and on !ok notify memory, sleep pollMs, continue. Requests without a footprintKey skip the memory rule. onWaiting fires only when the reason kind changes and listener errors are swallowed. Default deps: sampleMemory dynamically imports ../../dashboard/server/services/proc-memory.js and maps { memAvailable, memTotal }; readTreeRssBytes = readProcessTreeRssBytes; softReserveBytes resolved once per acquire via resolveSoftReserveBytes; readFootprintEstimate reads under the admission root. recordPeak writes recordGateFootprintPeak under the same root inside try/catch and is a no-op without a key. Update the module header comment. In the test file add sampleMemory: async () => null to the deps() helper, then add the six PRD WI-3 cases (case 5 includes the 1 GiB-baseline owner and the fullReservation owner) with fake timers and the existing drive helpers. Keep the file under its size cap (481 lines today; stay at or below 650 lines after both admission items).

items.title: Given 13 GiB available, a 12 GiB soft reserve and a 2.5 GiB default estimate, the waiter is not admitted after 10 polls and onWaiting receives kind 'memory' once; when sampleMemory then returns 20 GiB the waiter resolves with a handle

Given 2 slots, 3 keyed requests, 16 GiB available, a 12 GiB soft reserve and owners at 100 MiB tree RSS, the first is admitted and the second waits on memory with a slot free, leaving exactly one owner file
Given a footprint file with one 512 MiB peak for the key and 13 GiB available against a 12 GiB reserve, the waiter is admitted; without that file the same setup blocks on memory
When sampleMemory returns null or throws, admission falls back to the slot and CPU rules; a live owner file without footprintBytes reserves nothing

handle.recordPeak(3 GiB) creates a file under <rootDir>/footprints/ and a later acquire for the same key stores footprintBytes 3 GiB in its owner record; recordPeak without a footprintKey creates no file

Given a live owner with footprintBytes 2.5 GiB, rssBaselineBytes 1 GiB and a 1.1 GiB tree RSS, the head waiter's memory check counts a 2.4 GiB reservation; given fullReservation true, it counts 2.5 GiB even when the tree reads 3 GiB

expected_outputs: quality-gate-admission.test.ts reports all cases green including the post-settle and timeout-reason cases

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3b (FR-9 error part, FR-10, D10 post-settle part, D15). In src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.ts: give QualityGateAdmissionTimeoutError a readonly lastWaitReason: QualityGateWaitReason['kind'] | null (second constructor argument, default null) and, for 'memory', readonly lastMemory with the memory reason's numbers; the loop keeps the last reason passed to notifyWaiting and passes it when it throws on maxWaitMs. After await sleep(settleMs) and the existing CPU re-sample pass, when the request has a footprintKey: re-scan the slot files, keep live owners whose ticketId differs from its own, sampleMemory() again, run evaluateMemoryHeadroom with sumReservations(otherOwners) and its own footprint; on !ok unlink its own owner file only while sameOwner still holds, notifyWaiting memory, sleep pollMs, continue. A null or throwing sampleMemory passes. Tests with fake timers: memory drops from 20 to 13 GiB during the settle (owner file removed, waiter still queued, later admitted at 20 GiB); a memory-blocked waiter with maxWaitMs 5000 rejects with lastWaitReason 'memory', a CPU-blocked one with 'cpu'.

items.title: Given 20 GiB before publish and 13 GiB after the settle (12 GiB reserve, 2.5 GiB estimate), the queue deletes its own owner file, keeps the ticket queued and reports kind 'memory'; when reads return 20 GiB again the waiter resolves

Add the admitted-command runner behind the tsc wrapper

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Create src/lib/cloister/gate-admission-run.ts exporting tscFootprintKey(args) (tsc:<-p/--project value with leading ./ stripped>, else tsc:tsconfig.json), shouldBypassAdmission(env) (CI non-empty, OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION === '0', OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED === '1'), and runAdmittedCommand({ footprintKey, command, args, cwd }, deps) resolving to the exit code to use. Bypass: spawn directly. Otherwise acquire({ workspacePath: cwd, gateName: footprintKey, attempt: 1, footprintKey }, { maxWaitMs: 30 * 60_000, onWaiting }) where onWaiting writes one '[gate-admission] <key> waiting for memory: available X GiB, reserved Y GiB, needs Z GiB, soft reserve W GiB' line (one decimal) per reason change to stderr; on a QualityGateAdmissionTimeoutError whose lastWaitReason is 'memory' print '[gate-admission] refusing to start <key>: waited 30 minutes for memory (available X GiB, reserved Y GiB, needs Z GiB, soft reserve W GiB)' and resolve 75 without spawning; on any other throw warn '[gate-admission] proceeding without admission: <message>' and run unadmitted. Spawn with stdio inherit and OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1 in the env when admitted, start startPeakRssSampler on child.pid, forward SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP, remove listeners on exit. On exit: stop the sampler, recordPeak when code !== null and peak !== null, release in finally, resolve code or 128 + os.constants.signals[signal]. A spawn error releases, warns and resolves 1. No message may contain 'error TS'. All deps (acquire, spawn, startSampler, warn, env, maxWaitMs) are injectable.

items.title: When env has CI, OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 or OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1, runAdmittedCommand spawns the command without calling acquire

Given a fake child killed by SIGINT, runAdmittedCommand resolves 130 and records no peak

When acquire rejects with a CPU timeout or a generic error, runAdmittedCommand prints a 'proceeding without admission' warning and still spawns the command; when it rejects with lastWaitReason 'memory', it prints 'refusing to start', resolves 75 and never calls spawn

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 (D3). Create scripts/tsc-admitted.mjs (plain ESM, header comment naming PAN-5248 and usage 'node scripts/tsc-admitted.mjs <tsc args>'). Resolve tscBin = <cwd>/node_modules/.bin/tsc; when it is not executable print the ratchet scripts' '✖ missing node_modules/.bin/tsc — run 'bun install' first (never falling back to the npm registry).' line to stderr and exit 1 (never npx, PAN-3605). Otherwise: import { register } from 'tsx/esm/api', register(), dynamically import new URL('../src/lib/cloister/gate-admission-run.ts', import.meta.url).href, and set process.exitCode = await runAdmittedCommand({ footprintKey: tscFootprintKey(args), command: tscBin, args, cwd }).
